decisions.statement: A property a page type introduces is a property that page type declares.
A property a page type above declares is no introduction.
A property two page types introduce is passed over.
Every page type is judged whenever the change has a page type.
The properties a page type introduces are worked out once for the whole run.
A page type the change has is read as the change leaves the page type.
Which page types stand is read from the index as the change leaves the index.
The properties a page type above declares are read as the change leaves the page type above.
A page type is read from the page types gathered rather than looked for again.
A page type the gathering does not have is looked for in the index.
A part is matched by the slug the part addresses rather than by the page type the part names.
A change with no page type is passed over before the index is worked out.
A change taking a page type away is judged rather than passed over.
A page type the change takes away is not itself judged.
Where the property's page stands in the folders is not judged here.
A property a page type restates to narrow the property is no introduction.
A refusal names the page type judged rather than a path the change has.

definition: the check with a page type to naming the properties it introduces among its parts
